caption: A leaf blower is pointed at a pile of dry leaves on a path, and the leaves scatter and tumble away from the nozzle.

sa.check: A leaf blower is pointed at a pile of dry leaves on a path.
They tumble away from the nozzle.
The blast comes first and the scatter follows.

pc.expect: Leaves move away from the blower in the direction of the blast, some lifting into the air.
pc.fail: They move toward the blower; or sideways across the blast; or straight up and hover.

pc.expect: Leaves move only while the blast is on them.
pc.fail: They scatter with the blower off; or keep tumbling after it is switched off and the air is still; or move before it is aimed.

pc.expect: Lifted leaves come down and settle further along.
pc.fail: They hang; or rise indefinitely; or float.

pc.expect: The leaves flutter and tumble as thin dry things.
pc.fail: They move as rigid discs; or as rolling balls; or as one solid sheet.

pc.expect: One blower keeps its number, and the leaves are the pile's.
pc.fail: The blower duplicates; or leaves appear from nowhere; or leaves pass through the path.

pc.expect: The blower, the path and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The blower changes colour; or the path rearranges; or the leaves change colour.
